description: React component for a page allowing users to upload career-related documents (resume, job description, performance review), connect LinkedIn, and proceed to generate a persona.

classes.name: SuccessFileCard
classes.description: Component displaying uploaded file details with remove option.

classes.name: UploadCard
classes.description: Component for uploading a specific document type with visual feedback.

methods.name: kindLabel
methods.description: Returns label text for each document kind.

methods.name: kindHelp
methods.description: Returns help text for each document kind.

methods.name: formatBytes
methods.description: Formats byte size into human-readable string.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Refreshes the component state from persona flow state.

methods.name: getDocForKind
methods.description: Retrieves the first uploaded document matching a specific kind.

methods.name: upsertDoc
methods.description: Adds or updates a document of a specific kind.

methods.name: removeKind
methods.description: Removes a document of a specific kind.

methods.name: triggerError
methods.description: Sets error message and triggers shake animation.
